The live candidate now keeps the category order hidden but restores a visible completion horizon: a persistent progress bar shows an approximate percentage through required coverage plus rough remaining-question and time ranges. The estimate is explicitly approximate because one answer can satisfy several dimensions and answer length varies. Dynamic questioning, cross-thread reuse, global-label scope preservation, free-form synthesis review, and the target-theory-blind boundary remain intact. The remaining hard endpoint is still a fresh frozen interview that meets the historical DOB/time recovery benchmark.

ownerAuthority: The owner requires scientific coverage, a genuinely dynamic natural interview, and a visible estimate of remaining burden. All required constructs must eventually be resolved or explicitly missing, but what the participant already says must count across those constructs so later questions do not duplicate it. Fixed constructs do not authorize a fixed category order or literal re-asking, and hiding the category queue does not authorize an indefinite-feeling interview with no progress horizon. The owner also requires global self-label scope preservation, free-form nonfinal synthesis review, and retention of enough behavioral information to reproduce the historical owner DOB/time recovery. Owner-self post-freeze recovery is authorized; chart-aware elicitation, external-participant target scoring, recruitment, publication, merge/release, and broader target-model activity are not.
